title: All 15 Webots integration scenarios pass — CI runner isolation hardened
summary: This PR hardens dev Webots CI runner isolation by adding concurrency groups, GPU capacity waiting, per-run-attempt resource naming, and a dedicated cleanup step. All 15 scenarios (builtin, cap, flow) passed both before and after a stack restart, covering camera, lidar, mapping, memory, navigation, speech, voiceprint, explore, scene, and executor builtins. The scene LLM enrichment logged repeated JSONDecodeErrors from the fake-vlm endpoint, but these are non-fatal warnings and did not affect test outcomes.
pr_changes: Added concurrency group `robonix-webots-gpu-${{ inputs.gpu_id || vars.ROBONIX_CI_GPU_ID || '0' }}` with `cancel-in-progress: false` to prevent concurrent GPU test runs.
Introduced `RUN_ATTEMPT` and `RUN_KEY` environment variables to scope per-run-attempt resource names (containers, volumes, runtime directories).
Added `ROBONIX_CI_MIN_GPU_FREE_MIB` variable (default 4096) and a `Wait for runner GPU capacity` step that polls `nvidia-smi` for free memory before proceeding.
Set `VOICEPRINT_DEVICE=cpu` to keep build-time ECAPA verification off the GPU reserved for Webots and Scene.
Replaced `RUN_ID` with `RUN_KEY` in container names, project names, map IDs, and cleanup patterns to isolate per-attempt resources.
Removed the `Configure runner-local Robonix home` step and the explicit `ROBONIX_SIM_CONTAINER` env override in the restart step; now uses the `RUN_KEY`-based variable.
Added a `Clean runner-local run directory` step that validates and removes the runtime directory after the run.
Updated `testing/simulate_ci.py` to improve regex-based synthetic text generation for test assertions.
Added `--dimension-tolerance-cells` argument to `verify_scene_map_persistence.py` to allow small occupancy-grid dimension drift (default 2 cells).
test_result: All 15 scenarios passed (15/15, 100%) in both the initial run and after a stack restart. Coverage includes 20 capabilities across builtin executor tools, camera/lidar snapshots, mapping save, memory save/search, navigation, speech, voiceprint, explore, and scene object listing. The explore skill timed out as expected (5s and 8s ceilings), and the fault recovery scenarios correctly handled missing-file and missing-argument errors.

suggested_fix: Monitor the repeated `scene-graph-llm` JSONDecodeError warnings from the fake-vlm endpoint; they are non-fatal but may indicate a misconfiguration or timeout in the LLM enrichment loop. Consider adding a retry or fallback for LLM calls.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene LLM enrichment logs repeated JSONDecodeError warnings from fake-vlm; these are non-fatal but should be investigated if they persist in production.
The explore skill's 'nav leg failed: leg timeout' warnings are expected given the short timeouts, but may indicate navigation tuning opportunities.
The new GPU capacity waiting step adds up to 5 minutes of polling; ensure the timeout is adequate for shared runners.
